goal: Speed up functional test runs by waking polling loops immediately on P2P events instead of sleeping
Reduces idle wait times and avoids transaction relay delays to shorten CI and local test cycles
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Verified by testing functional test suite runtime and CPU reductions locally (aaron-leeb)

categories.name: tests
why: P2 because it cuts functional test suite wall time by up to 11% and accumulated CPU time by up to 17.5%
Significantly lowers the recurring turnaround time for developers running tests locally and in CI
Individual test runtimes drop substantially, with some running in a fraction of their prior time
